 cabinet.

Introduction
This document 
lists the testing procedures P1, which must be performed 
on annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. 
Islam Abd Alla, tested by eng. Islam Abd Alla, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Adel Abd El Qader El Nagar, 
accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Azab 
and approved by eng. Fawzy Sobhy Ismail Head Sector of 
Abu Sultan PS.
This document 
accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general 
director and MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed 
Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general director 
and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Isolate the equipment which its protection relay under test
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Isolate the equipment which its protection relay under test
Tools and Equipment
Current injection 
 device with timer.
Test plug, test leads
Test cabinet.
Work to be Carried Out
Enter the tested device in the tested 
 cabinet.
Connect a variable source of DC voltage 
 to the coil studs and checking the pickup voltage.
The relay should be adjusted by means of variable resistor 
 (R1) to the time delay required at it's final location 
 (see figure1)
Check the time delay by using digital 
 timing.
The target should pickup at or below it's 
 rating
Return Relay into Service
Return the relay 
 to the panel.
Withdraw the test plug 
 handle from the relay.
Return all connections to the normal position as before 
 the test.
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
Close the work permit
